comment: Copy this file to systems.json and edit for your systems. canonical_rules fold SDRTrunk's site-specific event-log names into one network identity, in order: each rule is either an exact-name map or a prefix match. Anything unmatched passes through unchanged. rr_sids maps canonical system names to RadioReference system ids (https://www.radioreference.com/db/sid/<id>) so the UI can deep-link to RR.
